resources.string: Focale regularly saves an encrypted copy of the vault to a folder of your choice: SD card, USB drive, folder synced by another app… The last 3 backups are kept, and each one restores with its password, like a manual backup.
Not stored: only a key derived from it stays on this device
First backup as soon as possible

Choose the password for automatic backups. You’ll need it to restore them, and it can’t be recovered. Focale doesn’t store it: only a key derived from it stays on this device, protected by the Android Keystore.
Password changed: the next backups will use it.
This folder can’t receive the backups. Choose another one.
No app on this device can choose a folder
Automatic backups in progress and their failures
The backup folder can no longer be reached. Choose it again in the vault.
Not enough space left in the backup folder.
The backup couldn’t be written. It will be retried next time.
The backup key is no longer available on this device. Enter the password again in the vault.
